reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is generating multivariate time series (MTS) while preserving conditional constraints (e.g., specific health indicators). Standard diffusion models struggle with this due to inconsistent sampling paths. The authors introduce two key innovations: a classifier-free adaptive maximum mean discrepancy (Ada-MMD) loss that directly enforces condition consistency without requiring a discriminator network, and a trend-peak decomposition residual U-Net (TDR-UNet) that explicitly captures long-term trends and short-term peaks, thereby incorporating temporal inductive bias. This combination enables stable, high-fidelity generation across diverse industrial datasets.
